info.title: One OCR Next API
info.description: Synchronous Linux OCR with OneOCR, optional DeepDoc page layout, preprocessing, post-OneOCR Needle JSON extraction, and direct ddddocr CAPTCHA text recognition on the same /v1/ocr endpoint. PDF input is rasterized page by page for OneOCR/Needle; ddddocr accepts images only. CAPTCHA mode is selected by extract=ddddocr and returns a distinct response without OneOCR lines, boxes, or confidence.

200.description: Models initialized; pending includes running, queued and uploading requests

post.summary: Recognize an image or PDF, or decode a CAPTCHA
post.description: Also available at /api/v1/ocr, /ocr and /. Authentication is required when ONEOCR_API_KEY is configured (required by the Compose deployment). Images and PDFs are processed in memory and are not persisted. Multi-page TIFF and animated GIF process the first page/frame only. PDFs are rasterized and OCRed sequentially per selected page; a page failure returns an error, not a partial response. Queue execution is serialized per engine. Deadlines include body upload, queue wait, rendering, recognition and optional extraction; cancellation cannot preempt an ONNX call already running. Layout, image preprocessing and post-OCR Needle JSON extraction are opt-in. `extract=needle` runs after OneOCR and requires multipart with an image/PDF file, a schema JSON text part and optional instruction; on PDFs it runs separately for each page. `extract=ddddocr` runs only the CAPTCHA model directly on one image and skips OneOCR. It accepts the CAPTCHA-specific `captcha_*` parameters below, rejects document OCR/PDF/layout/preprocessing options and schema/instruction, and rejects `captcha_*` options outside CAPTCHA mode. CAPTCHA responses have a distinct schema with top-level text and model metadata; no confidence or boxes are returned.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language alias or script. Use either language or script. Aliases include vi, en, zh, ja, ko, ru, ar, hi, el, th, he, ta.

parameters.name: extract
parameters.description: Optional extraction mode. `needle` runs schema-constrained JSON extraction after OneOCR and requires multipart plus schema. `ddddocr` performs direct single-image CAPTCHA OCR without OneOCR; it accepts raw or multipart image input, no schema/instruction, and only the `captcha_*` options listed below in addition to this parameter.

parameters.name: captcha_threshold
parameters.description: CAPTCHA-only cleanup. `auto` or an 8-bit grayscale threshold 0..255. Supplying this parameter opts into the CAPTCHA cleanup pipeline; omitted values resolve to auto when another cleanup setting enables the pipeline.

parameters.name: captcha_polarity
parameters.description: CAPTCHA-only cleanup foreground polarity. Supplying this parameter, including auto, opts into cleanup; omitted values resolve to auto when another cleanup setting enables the pipeline. Auto chooses the less-populated side of the threshold as foreground.

parameters.name: captcha_remove_lines
parameters.description: CAPTCHA-only straight-line filter selection. Grid selects both axes.

parameters.name: captcha_line_min_length_px
parameters.description: CAPTCHA-only minimum straight/wavy-line length on the bounded working raster. Tuning parameters require straight-line removal or enabled wavy-line removal. If omitted, straight horizontal defaults to max(8, ceil(65% work width)), vertical to max(8, ceil(90% work height)); wave paths use the greater of 8, ceil(80% work width) and this value.

parameters.name: captcha_line_max_width_px
parameters.description: CAPTCHA-only maximum straight/wavy-line width on the bounded working raster; defaults to 1. Tuning parameters require straight-line removal or enabled wavy-line removal.

parameters.name: captcha_remove_wavy_lines
parameters.description: CAPTCHA-only bounded thin-wave heuristic. Defaults to false. Explicit false alone preserves the existing model input path.

parameters.name: captcha_dots_max_area
parameters.description: CAPTCHA-only removal of connected foreground components up to this area in working-raster pixels; supplying it opts into cleanup.

parameters.name: layout
parameters.description: Optional semantic page-region detection. Requires the pinned local DeepDoc ONNX model. Layout tags regions; it does not reconstruct table rows or cells.

parameters.name: layout_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum DeepDoc class score; used only with layout=deepdoc.

parameters.name: max_regions
parameters.description: Maximum layout regions retained for this request; used only with layout=deepdoc.

parameters.name: max_dimension
parameters.description: Optional maximum for the longer image edge; only downsizes and preserves aspect ratio.

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.description: Optional clockwise-positive rotation in degrees. The output canvas expands and is filled white.

parameters.name: deskew
parameters.description: Estimate and apply bounded small-angle deskew when a clear horizontal-text projection peak is found.

parameters.name: padding
parameters.description: Optional white border, in pixels added to each edge.

parameters.name: pdf_dpi
parameters.description: PDF rasterization resolution; PDF input only. Defaults to 150 when omitted.

parameters.name: pdf_pages
parameters.description: PDF-only 1-based page numbers/ranges, for example 1,3-5. Page numbers are at most 1000000; the selector is at most 256 characters and contains no spaces. At most 20 pages; no duplicate/overlapping ranges. Without this parameter, all pages are selected only when the document has at most 20 pages.

requestBody.description: Default maximum body 20 MiB for normal OCR. `extract=ddddocr` limits the entire raw or multipart HTTP body to min(ONEOCR_MAX_BODY_BYTES, 8 MiB), including multipart overhead; accepts one image only, limited to min(ONEOCR_MAX_PIXELS, 4 million) decoded pixels and 2..4096 pixels per dimension with normalized width 8..512. CAPTCHA accepts only the CAPTCHA-specific `captcha_*` query options; schema/instruction fields and other query options return 422. Cleanup is off by default and operates on a grayscale working raster capped at 1200 pixels on the long edge and 1 megapixel; the fixed order is threshold/polarity, straight lines, wavy lines, dots, then model resize. `captcha_*` options outside CAPTCHA mode return 422. For other modes send one image or PDF. Multipart accepts one file or image field, never both. PDF pages are rasterized at 72..300 DPI; each page is limited to 12 million pixels and 10000 pixels per dimension, with 80 million pixels total across selected pages. At most 20 pages are processed. When extract=needle, send exactly one schema JSON text part and at most one instruction text part; schema/instruction errors return 422 before OCR. Unknown/duplicate query parameters are rejected.

file.description: One image or PDF file; for extract=ddddocr, one image only.

image.description: Alternative file field; do not send alongside file.

schema.description: JSON Schema text for extract=needle; rejected by extract=ddddocr.

instruction.description: Optional caller guidance for extract=needle; rejected by extract=ddddocr.

200.description: Normal image requests return OcrResult. PDF requests return PdfOcrResponse. With extract=needle, extraction appears in each page result. With extract=ddddocr, returns CaptchaOcrResponse with direct model text and no OneOCR line result; extraction.preprocessing appears when any captcha_* option is supplied.

json_extraction_model_available.description: Configured model file exists; it is not hash-verified or warmed by readiness.

extraction_pending.description: Reserved extraction request; includes body upload, OCR and extraction, not just active model inference.

layout.description: OneOCR's glyph orientation for this OCR line, not a semantic page-region label.

layout_region.description: Present for semantic-layout OCR; links this line to its DeepDoc page region.

class_id.description: Class 0 (_background_) is suppressed by this API.

elapsed_ms.description: Whole extraction phase: schema/context checks, model hash verification, first-use runtime/worker initialization, inference and abort cleanup when applicable.

data.description: Only present on success. Shape is the caller's accepted extraction schema; extra properties are rejected.

elapsed_ms.description: Includes preprocessing and OCR recognition; excludes request queue wait, image decode, HTTP body parsing and optional Needle extraction. For PDF page results, also excludes PDF page rasterization.

coordinate_space.description: Present for preprocessing, semantic layout, or PDF page results.

extraction.description: Present when extract=needle; OCR fields remain present for all extraction statuses.

text.description: Selected page OCR text joined in page order with line feed, form feed, line feed separators.

elapsed_ms.description: Full CAPTCHA phase, including first-use asset verification/session setup, preprocessing and inference.

preprocessing.description: Present when any captcha_* query option was supplied.

CaptchaRaster.description: When created is true, dimensions are after EXIF auto-orientation and scales are relative to the oriented source. When false, original decoder dimensions are reported with unit scales and null pixels.

enabled.description: False when a no-op option such as captcha_remove_wavy_lines=false was supplied alone.

text.description: Predicted text for success; empty string for no_match.

extraction.description: Direct CAPTCHA recognition metadata; no OneOCR lines, confidence, or bounding boxes.

BadRequest.description: Empty/invalid image or PDF, or malformed multipart

TooLarge.description: Body exceeds the configured limit; with extract=ddddocr, the entire request body is capped at min(ONEOCR_MAX_BODY_BYTES, 8 MiB).

InvalidOptions.description: Invalid query/options, schema, extraction mode, image dimensions, PDF selection/render bounds, encrypted/XFA PDF, CAPTCHA cleanup option values/combinations (including orphan line tuning), or CAPTCHA mode combination; raw image/PDF is not allowed when extract=needle. Using captcha_* outside extract=ddddocr returns captcha_options_unsupported.

InternalError.description: Internal engine failure; CAPTCHA inference/output failures use their documented 502 errors. Use request ID for logs.

CaptchaModelFailure.description: CAPTCHA image-processing, ONNX inference, or model-output contract failure

Busy.description: OCR queue full, service draining, Needle extraction slot, PDF renderer or CAPTCHA slot occupied

Timeout.description: Upload, queue, PDF rendering or recognition deadline exceeded
